caption:
What the righteous did in the last hours of night

Allah describes the righteous in gardens and springs, and tells us how they lived before: they slept little at night, and before dawn they sought forgiveness. Tonight, give a few quiet minutes before Fajr to asking Him.

Surah Adh-Dhaariyat 51:15-18

Set one alarm before Fajr and say Astaghfirullah when it rings

#istighfar #beforefajr #nightworship #quranreels

Recitation: Yasser Al-Dosari
alt_text: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and springs; receiving what their Lord will give them, for they were indeed doers of good beforehand. They used to sleep but little at night; and before dawn they would seek forgiveness (Surah Adh-Dhaariyat 51:15-18)
theme: seeking forgiveness before dawn / night worship
